meta.title: Waterfront Station → Water Street → Steam Clock / civic-aligned
meta.source: City of Vancouver public streets and 2015 approximate building footprints
buildNotes: Street centerlines are anchored to the City of Vancouver public-streets dataset.
Station building envelope uses the City 2015 approximate footprint; architectural detailing is authored and approximate.
Sidewalk widths, building heights, door positions and NPC movement are visual approximations, not survey measurements.
No live mapping API is called during gameplay.
The Station East surface lot is deliberately retained as open parking; proposed tower is not an existing building.
Parking outline and architectural textures are illustrative, with reference citations in the model source.
meta.provenanceSummary: Aligned to the connected 600/500 West Cordova and 200–300 Water public street centerlines; buildings from approximate 2015 city footprints.

artDirection.label: stylized realism with cinematic Vancouver rain-lighting
pillars: wet cobblestone reflections and low-angle dawn highlights
heritage masonry with richer brick-stone-glass contrast
dense civic clutter and postcard framing around the Steam Clock and Water Street bends
